name: X-LAB RS5
why_interesting: X-LAB's international aluminium endurance road bike: US$1,399 with Shimano 105 mechanical, a power-meter crankset and a carbon fork, an official 38C maximum tire clearance and 9.54 kg in size L. The official mainland store did not list it on 2026-10-27.
missing: Mainland China availability, price and seller route
Alloy specification beyond the X6 name
Independent complete-bike weight and stiffness evidence
price_status: official US list price converted as a CNY reference

official_price.price_basis: Official international RS5 at US$1,399, converted at the ECB reference cross-rate of 1 October 2026.
official_price.conditions: Foreign reference only; the US offer includes shipping in the contiguous U.S. Mainland availability and price, import duty, tax and the actual transaction rate are unknown.

source_note: Single official international build. The alloy frame is UDH compatible and uses endurance geometry; the fork, seatpost and wheels are not interchangeable evidence for the carbon RS7, RS8 or RS9.

facts.frame: XDS X6 aluminium-alloy frame, UDH compatible; XDS carbon fork
facts.frame_material: X6 aluminium-alloy frame and carbon fork; the alloy specification beyond the X6 name is unpublished
facts.brakes: Shimano 105 BR-R7170 hydraulic; Branta PN28 160/160 mm rotors
facts.crankset: Branta alloy power-meter crankset, 52/36T, 24 mm steel spindle
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, L and XL
facts.geometry: Official chart, stack/reach mm: XS 530/371, S 553/375, M 575/381, L 599/387, XL 623/394
